data.name: Dracula - Blood Moon
data.detailed_description:
🩸 Dracula: Blood Moon

The Blood Moon rises once every 333 years.

This time… it rises for you.

Dracula: Blood Moon is a dark, cinematic stealth-action RPG where you awaken as the legendary vampire lord—reborn in a land that believes you to be a myth. Weak, hunted, and betrayed by history, you must reclaim your power, rebuild your castle, and decide what kind of monster you will become.

Rule from the shadows. Feed to survive. Evolve into something the world cannot stop.

🌑 ABOUT THIS GAME

You awaken beneath the ruins of your fallen empire. The villages whisper your name. Hunters sharpen their stakes. Priests prepare their sermons.

As the Blood Moon cycle begins again, you must move carefully—hunting at night, manipulating factions, and reclaiming your dominion piece by piece.

But the Blood Moon does more than strengthen you…

It changes you.

🕯 FEATURES

🩸 Stealth & Predation

Hunt civilians, guards, priests, and rival hunters

Stalk rooftops, forests, crypts, and candle-lit corridors

Choose silent feeding or brutal execution

🌕 Blood Moon Transformation

Unlock devastating abilities during Blood Moon events

Enter a terrifying true form with enhanced strength and speed

Risk triggering large-scale hunter raids if you lose control

🏰 Reclaim Your Castle

Restore your throne room, alchemy lab, blood ritual chambers

Unlock relics tied to your forgotten past

Upgrade abilities through ancient blood rites

⚔ Living, Reactive World

Villages respond dynamically to your actions

Fear spreads. Curfews tighten. Hunters organize patrols

🕷 Choice & Morality

Manipulate mortals or slaughter them

Turn key characters into loyal thralls

Shape whether Dracula becomes legend… tyrant… or extinction event

🎬 CINEMATIC EXPERIENCE

Inspired by gothic horror and medieval political tension, Dracula: Blood Moon delivers:

Slow-burn atmospheric storytelling

Brutal melee combat with supernatural abilities

Dark orchestral soundtrack

High-fidelity environments powered by Unreal Engine

This is not a power fantasy from the start.

You earn your dominance.

🧛 Who Is This For?

Fans of:

Stealth-driven RPGs

Dark fantasy worlds

Castle building & progression systems

Moral choice narratives

Gothic horror storytelling

The Blood Moon approaches.

The hunters are ready.

Are you?

data.short_description: 🩸 Dracula: Blood Moon Dracula: Blood Moon is a cinematic stealth-action RPG set in a cursed kingdom where the Blood Moon rises once every 333 years. You awaken as Dracula—betrayed, weakened, and nearly forgotten—forced to rebuild your power in a land that fears your name.
